comment: All candidates share the same architecture, so optimizer progress decided the ranking. K1001 and K1002 supported Adam/AdamW over the very low-rate Adagrad; K1057 supported both Adam-family choices over RMSprop on univariate MSE. B’s higher Adam rate beat C’s slower AdamW recipe. K1072’s wide, deeper-network risk did not apply to this width-32, depth-1 model. Plain SGD was slow but not frozen (K1003), placing ahead of the near-stalled Adagrad candidate. This confirms existing scoped guidance without establishing a new rule.
